label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Dear Neighbors at Larkspur Lofts,

My name is Jess Okafor, and I live in 5A. I've been in the building for about three years. Some of you may have seen a note in the lobby about a drone being flown from the roof deck. That was me, and I'd like to explain what happened.

On Saturday, October 31, around 4pm, I flew a new drone from the roof deck for about eleven minutes. I'm a wedding photographer, and I was testing the equipment before an upcoming vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera faced west toward the river and the Fremont Bridge for the entire flight. It was never pointed at anyone's windows, balconies, or the courtyard.

I understand why it caused concern. A buzzing object hovering over the building is unsettling when you don't know who is flying it or why, and I've since learned that it frightened some of the kids in the building. I'm sorry for the worry it caused. I should have given people a heads-up beforehand.

If you'd like to see exactly what was recorded, I'm happy to show you the full, unedited footage. You can knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example, and we'll find a time.

Our HOA rules don't currently address drones, but I don't want to rely on that. I won't fly from the roof again unless the board sets a rule that allows it. I'll be asking for the topic to be added to the agenda for the board meeting on November 19 at 7pm in the community room. I'd welcome anyone's input there, whatever your view.

Finally, I want to say plainly that I was hurt to find my unit number posted in the lobby alongside the word "creep." I would much rather talk things through in person. If something I do concerns you in the future, please come and speak with me directly. I'll always be glad to listen.

Thank you for reading, and for being good neighbors.

Sincerely,

Jess Okafor
Unit 5A
